newsitem.title: POLAND: POLAND BANS HEAVY TRUCK MOVEMENT FROM JULY 4.
newsitem.headline: POLAND BANS HEAVY TRUCK MOVEMENT FROM JULY 4.

text.p: Poland banned heavy truck movement between 11 a.m. and 11 p.m. (0900 and 2100 GMT) from July 4 until further notice to limit damage to roads during a heat wave, the official PAP news agency said on Tuesday.

It quoted the Poland's public roads authorities as saying that the ban, affecting trucks weighting more than 12 tonnes, would apply from July 2 in the east and north-eastern provinces of Bialystok, Lomza and Suwalki.
The ban will not apply to truck carrying meat, fish, butter, eggs, fruit, grains and livestock, PAP said. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
